quotes.name: Ebony Owl Netsuke
quotes.flavor:
"Owls filled the skies during the Kami War, harbingers of darker times to come."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Hedron Crab
quotes.flavor: Hedrons perplex minds both great and small.

quotes.name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
quotes.flavor: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

quotes.name: Eater of Hope
quotes.flavor: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.flavor:
"For all the priceless tomes they have destroyed, one would think they would taste better."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: "Koh-koh noo-lahs boh ay-loh dah-noh-lah."

quotes.name: White Lotus Reinforcements
quotes.flavor:
"We're all part of the same ancient secret society, a group that transcends the divisions of the four nations."
—Master Piandao

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Jump
quotes.flavor:
"Humanity has always envied the power of flight. So we took it."
—Scytha, aeromage

quotes.name: Razorfoot Griffin
quotes.flavor: Like a meteor, it strikes from above without warning. Unlike a meteor, it then carries you off and eats you.

quotes.name: Debtors' Knell
quotes.flavor: One moment, conscious only of a sense of repose. The next moment, hearing the trudge of his own footsteps. He sighed and squinted into the glare ahead.

quotes.name: Burnout
quotes.flavor:
"GOTCHA!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

quotes.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
quotes.flavor: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor:
"You cannot be an Ojutai monk. They prize wisdom and skill, and you have neither."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

quotes.name: Liliana's Elite
quotes.flavor:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Squirrel Nest
quotes.flavor: In the Krosan Forest, you've got to keep an eye out for the squirrels.

quotes.name: Jennika's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"

quotes.name: Merciless Executioner
quotes.flavor: "Curse the Isengarders! Uglúk u bagronk sha pushdug Saruman-glob búbhosh skai!"

quotes.name: Ostrich-Horse
quotes.flavor: Ostrich-horses are renowned in the Earth Kingdom as reliable steeds for couriers, soldiers, and merchants.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor:
"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss."
—Ida Scott

quotes.name: Hammer Dropper
quotes.flavor: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Journal
quotes.flavor: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

quotes.name: Grim Tutor
quotes.flavor:
One who goes unpunished never learns.
—Greek proverb

quotes.name: The Peregrine Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Jhoira stumbled upon an ally, not just a good source of spare parts.

quotes.name: Towering-Wave Mystic
quotes.flavor: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

quotes.name: Zhao, the Seething Flame
quotes.flavor: "Stand and fight, Avatar!"

quotes.name: Fateful Absence
quotes.flavor: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

quotes.name: Authority of the Consuls
quotes.flavor: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

quotes.name: Ogre Arsonist
quotes.flavor:
"All of Ravnica's looking for you, Dack, from the Wojek on down."
—Maytov

quotes.name: Cryptic Gateway
quotes.flavor: Its lock changes to fit each key.

quotes.name: Carrion Beetles
quotes.flavor: It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye.

quotes.name: Cuboid Colony
quotes.flavor: It's chaotic in the midst of the swarm—only when you step back does the pattern emerge.

quotes.name: Hama Pashar, Ruin Seeker
quotes.flavor: "Someone took the time to carve these inscriptions. The least we can do is care enough to read them."

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.flavor: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Bloodbraid Challenger
quotes.flavor: Hasal knew hunting in the Rip would be dangerous. He didn't know it would be so much fun.

quotes.name: Skitter Eel
quotes.flavor:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Master Trinketeer
quotes.flavor: "Let us never forget the joy that lies at the heart of invention."

quotes.name: Feral Shadow
quotes.flavor: Not all shadows are cast by light—some are cast by darkness.

quotes.name: Inspiration
quotes.flavor:
"Day 31: I finally succeeded in my time reversal experiment!
"Day 30: I might have a problem here."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

quotes.name: Endless Atlas
quotes.flavor:
"While we slept, our inferiors infested the worlds that belong to us. Now, we awaken once more."
—Szarekh, the Silent King

quotes.name: Awe Strike
quotes.flavor: Stunned by the mere presence of the leonin kha, the nim raider quickly fell to its knees.

quotes.name: Seer's Lantern
quotes.flavor: A light to bring hope in dark times.

quotes.name: Peerless Samurai
quotes.flavor: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

quotes.name: Open the Graves
quotes.flavor: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

quotes.name: Desperate Farmer // Depraved Harvester
quotes.flavor: Once he'd tasted that dark power, there was no turning back.

quotes.name: Vanquish the Horde
quotes.flavor: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.

quotes.name: Failed Fording
quotes.flavor:
"We should have taken the blasted ferry!"
—Hope Hagan, prospector

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Syndicate Trafficker
quotes.flavor: "The price isn't negotiable, but I'm sure you'll agree it's fair."

quotes.name: Mightstone
quotes.flavor: While exploring the sacred cave of Koilos with his brother Mishra and their master Tocasia, Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: On guard for larger dangers, we underestimated the power and speed of the Imp's muck-crusted claws.

quotes.name: Runic Armasaur
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

quotes.name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power... and his hunger.

quotes.name: Byway Barterer
quotes.flavor: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

quotes.name: Feast on the Fallen
quotes.flavor: He only paused to catch his breath, not knowing that it would be his last.

quotes.name: Hunter's Insight
quotes.flavor:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Bumper Cars
quotes.flavor: For those needing instructions how to drive the bumper cars, there's a crash course.

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The essence of a red dragon burns within, always ready to rise with wrath.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

quotes.name: Burnished Hart
quotes.flavor: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

quotes.name: Pillardrop Warden
quotes.flavor: A giant statue of a dwarf is still a giant statue.

quotes.name: Inferno of the Star Mounts
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: The ancient dragon Imvaernarhro has earned his fiery nickname.

quotes.name: Oketra's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Cerulean Wyvern
quotes.flavor:
"Once, a Quirion asked why I was so cautious when the day was clear. I told him of the sky-blue hide of the cerulean wyvern, and he offered me double if I could conjure a strong tailwind!"
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Crimson Operative
quotes.flavor:
"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive."
—Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Wall of Frost
quotes.flavor:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

quotes.name: Angel's Feather
quotes.flavor: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Wilderness Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be so quick to reclaim the thawing lands. They might have acquired a taste for freedom."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Skysovereign, Consul Flagship
quotes.flavor: Engineers take inspiration form nature when it comes to efficiency and aerodynamics. Why not intimidation too?

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor:
"They're herbivores, not prey animals. Go startle one if you want to know the difference."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Volcanic Fallout
quotes.flavor:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

quotes.name: Day of Destiny
quotes.flavor:
"We can travel anywhere and everywhere in 'that old box,' as you call it. Regardless of space and time."
—The First Doctor

quotes.name: Obliterating Bolt
quotes.flavor: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned.""And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

quotes.name: Sadistic Hypnotist
quotes.flavor: "Victory in the pits is almost as rewarding as the methods I use to achieve it."

quotes.name: T'Chaka, Venerable King
quotes.flavor: "I am king of Wakanda. A line unbroken. A crown unconquered."

quotes.name: Shattered Acolyte
quotes.flavor: "Just because Extus is gone doesn't mean the rest of us disappeared. We are here, and we are still seeking answers."

quotes.name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice
quotes.flavor: "I will be your monster no more."

quotes.name: Arcane Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Binding Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

quotes.name: Staying Power
quotes.flavor: Mongo's fleas no longer bothered him. But the family of goblins that had moved in behind his left ear was starting to get really irritating.

quotes.name: Opportunity
quotes.flavor:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Kitesail Corsair
quotes.flavor: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Temple of Mystery
quotes.flavor: Fear the glow, not the dark.

quotes.name: Crushing Vines
quotes.flavor:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Bloom Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

quotes.name: Kargan Dragonrider
quotes.flavor: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

quotes.name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
quotes.flavor:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Executioner's Capsule
quotes.flavor: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

quotes.name: Call for Aid
quotes.flavor:
"We must hasten. The beacons of Gondor are alight. War is kindled."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Archon of Emeria
quotes.flavor:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Nightfire Giant
quotes.flavor: Nightfire turns the greatest weakness of the undead into formidable strength.

quotes.name: Shivan Reef
quotes.flavor: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

quotes.name: Comforting Counsel
quotes.flavor: In the grief that followed the Invasion, Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

quotes.name: Radiant Flames
quotes.flavor: The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Finale of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

quotes.name: Thundering Giant
quotes.flavor: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Twilight
quotes.flavor:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Tezzeret's Strider
quotes.flavor:
"More obedient than any dog."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
quotes.flavor: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

quotes.name: Letter of Acceptance
quotes.flavor: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.

quotes.name: Majestic Metamorphosis
quotes.flavor: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

quotes.name: Deathcap Cultivator
quotes.flavor: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Highland Weald
quotes.flavor:
"Our noble land, enslaved by Rime,
Is it our fate to freeze through time?
If this be true, oh wicked crime."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

quotes.name: Vedalken Mastermind
quotes.flavor: The vedalken see other beings from a cold distance, as either experimental subjects or objects of study.

quotes.name: Silverflame Squire // On Alert
quotes.flavor: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

quotes.name: Brindle Boar
quotes.flavor: The war lasted for generations. The boars didn't need to hunt for food anymore. They fed on the fallen corpses, and the living fed off of them.

quotes.name: Magmaquake
quotes.flavor:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Sigil of Sleep
quotes.flavor: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

quotes.name: Seal of Removal
quotes.flavor:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: Tree of Perdition
quotes.flavor: There will be no absolution.

quotes.name: Cenn's Enlistment
quotes.flavor: The more the scarier.

quotes.name: Rule of Law
quotes.flavor: Appointed by the kha himself, members of the tribunal ensure all disputes are settled with the utmost fairness.

quotes.name: Deglamer
quotes.flavor: The more pleasant an illusion's garb, the more indecent its form laid bare.

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

quotes.name: Fuel for the Cause
quotes.flavor: "Your ideas will be discarded and your will repurposed."

quotes.name: Cyber Conversion
quotes.flavor: "Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."

quotes.name: Flaming Sword
quotes.flavor:
"It's not Talruum crystal, but I must admit—it gets the job done."
—Tahngarth

quotes.name: Molten Duplication
quotes.flavor: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

quotes.name: Vampire's Kiss
quotes.flavor: Young vampires gorge themselves at every meal, but their elders have learned to savor the smallest bite.

quotes.name: Rust
quotes.flavor:
"How dull it is to pause, to make an end,/ To rust unburnished, not to shine in use,/ As though to breathe were life!"
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "Ulysses"

quotes.name: Westfold Rider
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The Orcs were greater in number than we counted on. Great Orcs, who also bore the White Hand of Isengard."
—Éomer

quotes.name: Magus of the Tabernacle
quotes.flavor: The Tabernacle's disciples channel the emanations from Pendrell Vale, spreading its paradoxical demand to be both worshipped and left alone.

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor: In the end, he marched into the desert sands, leaving the Vault behind him.

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

quotes.name: Cruel Reality
quotes.flavor: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.flavor:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

quotes.name: Spitting Earth
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"

quotes.name: Thermo-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

quotes.name: Cenn's Tactician
quotes.flavor: "A well-trained force brings peace . . . which brings more time for training!"

quotes.name: Primeval Titan
quotes.flavor: When nature calls, *run*.

quotes.name: Pyrokinesis
quotes.flavor:
"Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

quotes.name: Errant, Street Artist
quotes.flavor: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.

quotes.name: Sai, Master Thopterist
quotes.flavor: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

quotes.name: Palace Guard
quotes.flavor: "I'm not nearly as bothered by being outnumbered as I am by their foul stench."

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Water surges in a mysterious crater created eons ago, revered by batfolk as a nexus for the cosmos.

quotes.name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
quotes.flavor: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

quotes.name: Kraul Raider
quotes.flavor: The kraul once skulked in the outskirts of Golgari society, but with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.

quotes.name: Warfire Javelineer
quotes.flavor: Minotaurs favor magic that manifests as weapons wrapped in flame.

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

quotes.name: Naya Panorama
quotes.flavor: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

quotes.name: Ogre Taskmaster
quotes.flavor: Ogres learn how to smash stuff even before they learn how to walk.

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Talisman of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"Thus is the friendship of the Mark and of Gondor bound with a new bond, and the more do I rejoice."
—Éomer

quotes.name: Ambition's Cost
quotes.flavor:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
quotes.flavor: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

quotes.name: Execute
quotes.flavor:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Warren Soultrader
quotes.flavor: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

quotes.name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
quotes.flavor: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

quotes.name: Sacred Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Braid of Fire
quotes.flavor: "To a trained mind, the cold is but a momentary distraction."

quotes.name: Rush of Battle
quotes.flavor: The Mardu charge reflects the dragon's speed—and its hunger.

quotes.name: Righteous Blow
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters will no longer find safety under the mists of Morkrut!"
—Bruna, Light of Alabaster

quotes.name: Reincarnation
quotes.flavor:
"You cannot imagine what eyes you may look through tomorrow."
—Aerona, elder druid

quotes.name: Earthshaker Dreadmaw
quotes.flavor:
"I suggest we leave this cavern for someone else to conquer."
—Amalia, master cartographer

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Journal
quotes.flavor: Entry 711: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

quotes.name: Angel of Mercy
quotes.flavor: A song of life soars over fields of blood.

quotes.name: Dark Confidant
quotes.flavor: "Fare you well, Bringer of Light."

quotes.name: Razia, Boros Archangel
quotes.flavor: Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.

quotes.name: Saltwater Stalwart
quotes.flavor: Every attack is a test of your defenses. Every hit marks the map of your defeat.

quotes.name: Gigantoad
quotes.flavor: The gigantoad is known to venture outside of its comfort zone during downpours—much to the surprise of unsuspecting hikers.

quotes.name: Spiteful Prankster
quotes.flavor: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

quotes.name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
quotes.flavor: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

quotes.name: Skirk Prospector
quotes.flavor: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

quotes.name: Zndrsplt's Judgment
quotes.flavor: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun, but she still knows the penalties better than anyone else.

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

quotes.name: Growing Ranks
quotes.flavor:
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness."
—Trostani

quotes.name: Mistfolk
quotes.flavor:
"Although my official log will state there is no evidence pointing to the existence of the Mistfolk, my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Rumor Gatherer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

quotes.name: Cyclonic Rift
quotes.flavor: "I'll try to watch out for you, too."

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Bogardan Dragonheart
quotes.flavor: A hunger to soar must be sated.

quotes.name: Speaker of the Heavens
quotes.flavor: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Fanatical Offering
quotes.flavor: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.flavor: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

quotes.name: Sunscorch Regent
quotes.flavor:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Talisman of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"Any Cadian who can't field-strip their own lasgun by age ten was born on the wrong planet."
—Anonymous

quotes.name: Haughty Djinn
quotes.flavor: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

quotes.name: Quicksmith Genius
quotes.flavor: Quicksmiths are eager to jump from one project to the next, relying on flashes of inspiration rather than careful research.

quotes.name: Tel-Jilad Defiance
quotes.flavor: The Viridian elves had purged their culture of the trolls' traitorous influence. In times of strife, however, the ancestral memories returned.

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

quotes.name: Vandalblast
quotes.flavor: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

quotes.name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Only one loyal subject did not fear the wrath of the Marchioness—her beloved "Fluffin."

quotes.name: Soul of the Harvest
quotes.flavor: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

quotes.name: Aberrant Return
quotes.flavor: Shadowmoor is rife with wild magic—powerful but as volatile as the plane itself.

quotes.name: Price of Glory
quotes.flavor:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: The Railroad is an organization dedicated to freeing synths from the influence of the Institute. Their HQ is a secret location found by following the Freedom Trail.

quotes.name: Redtooth Genealogist
quotes.flavor: Some family trees are thornier than others.

quotes.name: Knight of Sorrows
quotes.flavor: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

quotes.name: Tooth and Claw
quotes.flavor:
"You deify nature as female—kind and gentle—yet you cringe at what is natural."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: The Tarrasque
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: When it rises, nations fall.

quotes.name: Sanctum Prelate
quotes.flavor: *Whispered Memories*, by Johannes Voss

quotes.name: Veteran Armorer
quotes.flavor: "Give me a sword and I'll kill a few enemies. But give me a hammer and a fiery forge, and I'll turn the tide of battle."

quotes.name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
quotes.flavor: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

quotes.name: Blossoming Bogbeast
quotes.flavor:
As subtle as a bogbeast
—Witherbloom expression meaning
"crude and clumsy"

quotes.name: Lupine Prototype
quotes.flavor:
"Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known. Can such genius be taught?"
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Levitation
quotes.flavor: "We'll be easy targets if we remain on the ground. Let's take the fight to them."

quotes.name: Venom
quotes.flavor: "I told him it was just a flesh wound, a wee scratch, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Cloudkin Seer
quotes.flavor: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

quotes.name: Seal of the Guildpact
quotes.flavor:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Earth Elemental
quotes.flavor: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

quotes.name: Orcish Oriflamme
quotes.flavor: The orcs' banner sends a clear message: "Stand against us and meet the same fate as the goblins."

quotes.name: Chart a Course
quotes.flavor:
"Let's go somewhere no calamity can follow."
—Otho Darkclaw, reformed river pirate

quotes.name: Mephitic Draught
quotes.flavor:
"Don't look at me. I'm not drinking it."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain

quotes.name: The Wind Crystal
quotes.flavor: "I give unto you the last of my light, and with it, the last hope of a fading world."

quotes.name: Gurmag Rakshasa
quotes.flavor: "It's a pity to hoard life essence in a form so weak. Give it to me."

quotes.name: Starnheim Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

quotes.name: Pristine Talisman
quotes.flavor: Each cloak was fastened about the neck with a brooch like a green leaf veined with silver.

quotes.name: Phial of Galadriel
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I would rather be a heretic than betray my conscience."

quotes.name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
quotes.flavor: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

quotes.name: Soul Shatter
quotes.flavor: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

quotes.name: Razor Rings
quotes.flavor:
"There's someone in there! He's bending the vines!"
—Sokka

quotes.name: Ohran Frostfang
quotes.flavor: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

quotes.name: Bombard
quotes.flavor:
"Go back to your little war, sun-stooge! This here is *our* operation!"
—Kunthaar, Kav mine operator

quotes.name: Study Break
quotes.flavor: "You've been cramming all night. You're taking a nap whether you like it or not."

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Shelter
quotes.flavor: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

quotes.name: Drogskol Reaver
quotes.flavor: Wracked and warped with anguish, it obsessively seeks out other souls to hoard within its eternal prison.

quotes.name: Agent of the Fates
quotes.flavor: "You are breathing borrowed air."

quotes.name: Maalfeld Twins
quotes.flavor:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Gisa the Mad

quotes.name: Ant Queen
quotes.flavor:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

quotes.name: Tegan Jovanka
quotes.flavor: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

quotes.name: Boon of Emrakul
quotes.flavor: All around Emrakul, life re-formed in her image.

quotes.name: Valor in Akros
quotes.flavor: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: "Ah-noo wee-tee kah wah-tees."

quotes.name: Goblin-town
quotes.flavor: The passages were crossed and tangled in all directions, and it was most horribly stuffy.

quotes.name: Rumor Gatherer
quotes.flavor: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

quotes.name: Clifftop Retreat
quotes.flavor: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

quotes.name: Vulpine Goliath
quotes.flavor:
"With a diet of hydras, giants, and massive serpents, anything would get that big."
—Corisande, Setessan hunter

quotes.name: Horned Turtle
quotes.flavor: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

quotes.name: Bright Reprisal
quotes.flavor: Vampires know blood and the systems that carry it. And they know exactly where to strike to set it free.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor:
"We learn so much from the relics we find. What might we have learned from the relics we lost?"
—Kirol

quotes.name: Hive Stirrings
quotes.flavor: Sliver young are sorted into clutches according to their potential and their future role. Human scholars can only guess how those are determined.

quotes.name: Sunspear Shikari
quotes.flavor: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides. The fight for survival reunited them.

quotes.name: Seeker of the Way
quotes.flavor: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

quotes.name: Hope Tender
quotes.flavor: Some refused to leave their shattered homes, vowing to rebuild at any cost.

quotes.name: Frozen Shade
quotes.flavor: "There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade." —Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

quotes.name: Witch's Web
quotes.flavor: Ever since the ritual, Ryla didn't have an appetite at the dinner table, but her long walks in the forest always seemed to satiate her hunger.

quotes.name: Goblin General
quotes.flavor: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

quotes.name: Taurean Mauler
quotes.flavor: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

quotes.name: Daghatar the Adamant
quotes.flavor: "Our victories will protect a thousand generations."

quotes.name: Dragon Cultist
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You know that mighty dracoliches will one day rule over this world. For you, that day can't come soon enough.

quotes.name: Bitter Reunion
quotes.flavor: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

quotes.name: Vine Trellis
quotes.flavor: Nature twists knots stronger than any rope.

quotes.name: Grixis Panorama
quotes.flavor: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

quotes.name: Attended Healer
quotes.flavor: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."

quotes.name: Dutiful Knowledge Seeker
quotes.flavor: Wan Shi Tong rewards those who provide rare and insightful tomes.

quotes.name: Hammerfist Giant
quotes.flavor:
"Oh sure, they buy a lot of ale, but I always find myself needing to rebuild after the giants have paid a visit."
—Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

quotes.name: High-Society Hunter
quotes.flavor: She preys on Thraben's elites, known for their sophisticated taste.

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Curse of Predation
quotes.flavor:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Tempting Witch
quotes.flavor:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

quotes.name: Lawbringer
quotes.flavor:
One injustice starts a thousand riots. One law stops a thousand crimes.
—Lawbringer creed

quotes.name: Vernal Fen
quotes.flavor:
"You are here because the outside world rejects you. The Foot is your family. I am your father."
—Shredder

quotes.name: Killian, Ink Duelist
quotes.flavor: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."

quotes.name: Project Deathlok Soldier
quotes.flavor: "ENERGY OUTPUT AT 97.003%. WAKE UP, DEATHLOK UNIT. REPEAT: WAKE UP."

quotes.name: Aeolipile
quotes.flavor:
"Although fragile, the Aeolipile could be quite destructive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

quotes.name: Collective Unconscious
quotes.flavor: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: Anrakyr the Traveler awoke from his slumber with a singular goal: to rebuild a united Necron galaxy.

quotes.name: Sungrace Pegasus
quotes.flavor: The sacred feathers of the pegasus are said to have healing powers.

quotes.name: White Knight
quotes.flavor: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

quotes.name: Reptilian Reflection
quotes.flavor: Danger often lurks in the allure of crystal shards.

quotes.name: Steel Leaf Champion
quotes.flavor: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

quotes.name: Haunter of Nightveil
quotes.flavor: The Dimir employ the spirits of Ravnica's ancient, nameless dead, guiding their malevolence toward selected victims.

quotes.name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
quotes.flavor: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

quotes.name: Vandalblast
quotes.flavor: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

quotes.name: Elemental Eruption
quotes.flavor: The crater screamed into the wind, and the wind carried its blazing voice across the sky.

quotes.name: Archetype of Aggression
quotes.flavor:
"Did Purphoros bless Maikal because of his rage? Or did Maikal's rage blossom after he'd been blessed? Only the gods know."
—Eocles, oracle of Purphoros

quotes.name: Suspicious Shambler
quotes.flavor: It was the perfect disguise—at least until its stomach started moaning.

quotes.name: Pyroclasm
quotes.flavor:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

quotes.name: Brago's Representative
quotes.flavor: On Fiora, no matter is settled until King Brago offers an opinion.

quotes.name: Veinwitch Coven
quotes.flavor: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

quotes.name: Spiteful Banditry
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"One ill turn deserves another."
—Saruman

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor:
"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember."
—Clara Oswald

quotes.name: Unchained Berserker
quotes.flavor: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.

quotes.name: Frilled Oculus
quotes.flavor:
"Understand the Simic? That's about as easy as winning a staring contest with a homunculus."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

quotes.name: Suspicious Bookcase
quotes.flavor: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled *Camouflage and Its Practical Applications*.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
quotes.flavor: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

quotes.name: Chivalric Alliance
quotes.flavor: "I dub thee Syr Hellraker. For now."

quotes.name: Sea Monster
quotes.flavor: "Abandon ship!"

quotes.name: Goblin Fireslinger
quotes.flavor: A rock between your eyes hurts. A burning rock between your eyes ruins your whole day.

quotes.name: Consulate Skygate
quotes.flavor: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.

quotes.name: Syphon Flesh
quotes.flavor: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

quotes.name: Stitch in Time
quotes.flavor: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Altar
quotes.flavor: Offerings must first be freed from the prison of their own skin before they're welcomed into the Flesh Singularity.

quotes.name: Cover of Darkness
quotes.flavor: An Assassin has no weapon as deadly and no ally as dependable as the shroud of night.

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "I am the bridge between sea and sky. Wind and waves alike rise at my whim."

quotes.name: Thing from the Deep
quotes.flavor: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.

quotes.name: Helm of Awakening
quotes.flavor: Perhaps things would have ended differently had its first gasping breath not been lost in the susurrus of shifting sands.

quotes.name: Runeclaw Bear
quotes.flavor:
"Nature has grown tired of the impositions of men and will begin to outfit its creations with tools for bloody instruction."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Murderous Compulsion
quotes.flavor: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

quotes.name: Anaba Shaman
quotes.flavor: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

quotes.name: Assemble the Entmoot
quotes.flavor: "Boom, boom, rumboom, boorar, boom boom, dahrar boom boom, dahrar boom..."

quotes.name: Angelic Page
quotes.flavor: If only every message were as perfect as its messenger.

quotes.name: Liliana's Specter
quotes.flavor:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Elektra, Daughter of the Hand
quotes.flavor: "I am Elektra Natchios. Not even the stars are safe in the sky."

quotes.name: Valkyrie Harbinger
quotes.flavor: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

quotes.name: Oko's Accomplices
quotes.flavor: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.

quotes.name: Atlas, Sizable Stooge
quotes.flavor: "I wish you guys would fire your weapons a little down and to the left. I've got an itch under my ribs like you wouldn't believe!"

quotes.name: The Curve Keeper
quotes.flavor: THE

quotes.name: Blazing Crescendo
quotes.flavor:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Mascot Exhibition
quotes.flavor:
"Don't just win the game. Win the crowd."
—Moriana, Mage Tower coach

quotes.name: Righteous Charge
quotes.flavor: Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul.

quotes.name: Horn of the Mark
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Éowyn

quotes.name: Repel Calamity
quotes.flavor: The living seasons come to grow, to burn, to wither, and to freeze. As natural as it is for the Calamity Beasts to live, it is just as natural for them to die.

quotes.name: Underworld Connections
quotes.flavor: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

quotes.name: Flooded Grove
quotes.flavor: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

quotes.name: Price of Glory
quotes.flavor:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

quotes.name: Titania's Chosen
quotes.flavor:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

quotes.name: Impervious Greatwurm
quotes.flavor: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

quotes.name: Rot Shambler
quotes.flavor:
"If I die, feed me to a shambler. At least that way I'll be doing some good."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

quotes.name: Okina, Temple to the Grandfathers
quotes.flavor: If a land can be said to have a heart, Okina is the heart of Kamigawa.

quotes.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

quotes.name: Jwari Shapeshifter
quotes.flavor: "The best expedition would be an entire team of me."

quotes.name: Pandemonium
quotes.flavor:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

quotes.name: Sleep
quotes.flavor:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

quotes.name: Impact Tremors
quotes.flavor:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

quotes.name: As Foretold
quotes.flavor: "It is returning through the dark. And then, Doctor? Oh, but then he will knock four times."

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

quotes.name: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser
quotes.flavor: "We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Makeshift Battalion
quotes.flavor: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

quotes.name: Coastal Peak
quotes.flavor:
"Once again, a nice weekend in the countryside does *not* mean your industrial campus a few miles from downtown, Tony!"
—Pepper Potts

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Rootbound Crag
quotes.flavor: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor:
"The Empire is snuffing out Returners wherever it finds them. We must find a way to strike back before it's too late..."
—Returner soldier

quotes.name: Archangel Avacyn // Avacyn, the Purifier
quotes.flavor:
"Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer."
—Grete, cathar apostate

quotes.name: Runic Shot
quotes.flavor: "Target acquired."

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Serene Heart
quotes.flavor:
"If magic is your crutch, cast it aside and learn to walk without it."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Veteran's Voice
quotes.flavor:
"Good soldiers rely first upon their training, then upon their instincts."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Martial Coup
quotes.flavor: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

quotes.name: Squawkroaster
quotes.flavor: As Sanar watched the tangle of chirps and flames run by, his eyes lit up. "I want one," he whispered.

quotes.name: Meteorite
quotes.flavor: "And if I'm lying," he began . . .

quotes.name: Death's Presence
quotes.flavor: The Genestealer Cults rejoiced at the arrival of their gods . . . at first.

quotes.name: Essence Scatter
quotes.flavor:
"The greatest victory is a battle unfought."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

quotes.name: Alabaster Kirin
quotes.flavor: The appearance of a kirin signifies the passing or arrival of an important figure. As word of sightings spread, all the khans took it to mean themselves. Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

quotes.name: Explosive Apparatus
quotes.flavor:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

quotes.name: Azure Drake
quotes.flavor: More so than "storm" or "pirate," "drake" is the word a sailor least wants to hear.

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elder
quotes.flavor:
"Do we know what we're doing? Yes—the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

quotes.name: Troublesome Spirit
quotes.flavor: As erratic and turbulent as a summer squall.

quotes.name: Llanowar Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

quotes.name: Judge's Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

quotes.name: Benalish Cavalry
quotes.flavor: "My people swore to protect Benalia to the end. It is battered, but yet stands, as do we."

quotes.name: Wight of Precinct Six
quotes.flavor: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

quotes.name: Battlefield Promotion
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

quotes.name: Conquer
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we trade with those despicable elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Triskelion
quotes.flavor:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

quotes.name: Kami of Fire's Roar
quotes.flavor:
"I can hear the shamans chanting in the hills. They say their magic will protect us from the kami, that our gold has bought our safety. But no one sleeps soundly tonight."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Reito

quotes.name: Master Biomancer
quotes.flavor: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

quotes.name: Stampeding Horncrest
quotes.flavor: When the golden city opened, the dinosaurs inside were eager to greet the new visitors.

quotes.name: Vicious Hunger
quotes.flavor: Only the most ravenous soul feeds on the health of the weak.

quotes.name: Growth Spurt
quotes.flavor: MORE TO LOVE: Friendly, nature-loving, Bunyonesque SEM seeks SEF looking for a huge commitment. . . . seeks atog prince

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

quotes.name: Obsidian Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: It's the flint that sparks a warrior's rage.

quotes.name: Getaway Car
quotes.flavor: For those who need to make a quick departure without attracting undue attention.

quotes.name: Anurid Brushhopper
quotes.flavor: It's so tough it can frighten *itself* into hiding.

quotes.name: Gruul Signet
quotes.flavor: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

quotes.name: Crucible of Fire
quotes.flavor:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Drastic Revelation
quotes.flavor: Every disaster holds mystery, for lack of a sane witness.

quotes.name: Kindred Dominance
quotes.flavor: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

quotes.name: Hero of Goma Fada
quotes.flavor: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

quotes.name: Golgari Germination
quotes.flavor: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

quotes.name: Divebomber Griffin
quotes.flavor: Justice flies swiftly on angry wings.

quotes.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
quotes.flavor: In her friends she inspires loyalty. In her enemies, mutiny.

quotes.name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
quotes.flavor: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

quotes.name: Iceridge Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"Even dragons avoid Glintglaze Lake in this season. Which of you youngsters can tell me why?"
—Teacher Eliam

quotes.name: Creeping Mold
quotes.flavor:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

quotes.name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
quotes.flavor: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"

quotes.name: Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror
quotes.flavor: . . . but even the unbreakable can be reshaped.

quotes.name: Ritual of Steel
quotes.flavor:
"Our soldiers are blessed with lizard scales as hard and cold as steel."
—Sidar Jabari

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

quotes.name: Incandescent Aria
quotes.flavor: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

quotes.name: Command the Stage
quotes.flavor: Stingerquill admits only the fiercest hearts.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Mire
quotes.flavor:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Helm of Awakening
quotes.flavor:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

quotes.name: Obsessive Astronomer
quotes.flavor: "Sleep? I can sleep when I'm dead!"

quotes.name: Senu, Keen-Eyed Protector
quotes.flavor:
"Be my eyes, Senu!"
—Bayek of Siwa

quotes.name: Rain of Thorns
quotes.flavor: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

quotes.name: Thraben Inspector
quotes.flavor: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

quotes.name: Flowstone Wall
quotes.flavor: The rebels assaulted the wall, never suspecting the wall would assault back.

quotes.name: Hulking Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Phyrexian War Beast
quotes.flavor:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Skyraker Giant
quotes.flavor: She will not be content until hers is the highest head in the sky.

quotes.name: Ominous Roost
quotes.flavor:
"One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse. I don't know what this is, but it can't be good."
—Verna, priest of Sigarda

quotes.name: Lord of the Undead
quotes.flavor:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: All suns must set.

quotes.name: Commune with Beavers
quotes.flavor: "Guy speak beaver."

quotes.name: Mire Triton
quotes.flavor: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

quotes.name: Root Manipulation
quotes.flavor: "Nature endures and adapts, and so shall we."

quotes.name: Hordeling Outburst
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

quotes.name: Rishkar's Expertise
quotes.flavor: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor:
"Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

quotes.name: Kabira Outrider
quotes.flavor: Ondu moas make wildly uncomfortable mounts, but for determined warriors, their speed is enough to make up for it.

quotes.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
quotes.flavor: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

quotes.name: Standing Troops
quotes.flavor: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

quotes.name: Lambholt Elder // Silverpelt Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"Be wary of the seemingly gentle souls. The weak here were slaughtered long ago."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

quotes.name: Somberwald Spider
quotes.flavor: Stensian vampires encourage spiders near their manors so they can rob the webs.

quotes.name: Frog-Squirrels
quotes.flavor: Some of the mysterious croaking and chittering heard in the Foggy Swamp can be traced back to frog-squirrels, who hop along the canopy and snack on giant insects.

quotes.name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

quotes.name: Spirebluff Canal
quotes.flavor: There's so much more to Ghirapur than can be accessed by traditional roads.

quotes.name: Karametra's Acolyte
quotes.flavor: "The wilds are a garden tended by divine hands."

quotes.name: Valor in Akros
quotes.flavor: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

quotes.name: Headsplitter
quotes.flavor: Your own personal problem-solver.

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Tablet of Epityr
quotes.flavor: Originally considered the work of Urza, this tablet was created by forgers seeking to imitate Urza's masterpieces.

quotes.name: Blighted Fen
quotes.flavor:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

quotes.name: Weight of Memory
quotes.flavor: In lives that have stretched for centuries, there are bound to be a few awkward silences.

quotes.name: Wanderwine Hub
quotes.flavor: Below the great river, a bustling hub channels the flow of merrow trade.

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

quotes.name: Gift of Strength
quotes.flavor: The Nessian Wood is never without defenders.

quotes.name: The Mycosynth Gardens
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Child of Night
quotes.flavor: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Mindblade Render
quotes.flavor: "There will be no secrets between us... like it or not."

quotes.name: Glamer Gifter
quotes.flavor: "It's hardly even a prank in Velis Vel. It's just the way things work here."

quotes.name: Gaze of Pain
quotes.flavor: Remove the guardians to ensure your victory.

quotes.name: Lightning Hounds
quotes.flavor: Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.

quotes.name: Alania's Pathmaker
quotes.flavor: "The frogfolk should worry less that the sky is falling and worry more about where it's landing."

quotes.name: Final Parting
quotes.flavor:
"Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Wall of Heat
quotes.flavor: At a distance, we mistook the sound for a waterfall . . .

quotes.name: Virus Beetle
quotes.flavor: The Eumidian biotechs were delighted when a mutated malware gene devastated their systems. They'd encourage the trait, so long as future clutches could be contained.

quotes.name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
quotes.flavor: Those who interrupt the great scientist often find themselves testing the safety limits of his arcane inventions.

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Kitchen Imp
quotes.flavor: Action: Show an imp that's a kitchen helper for Asmor, the Underworld Cook.

quotes.name: Carrion Feeder
quotes.flavor: It has no respect for the deeds of martyrs, reducing their legacy to a mouthful of flesh.

quotes.name: Incriminate
quotes.flavor:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

quotes.name: Kataki, War's Wage
quotes.flavor:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

quotes.name: Crop Rotation
quotes.flavor: "Hmm ... maybe lotuses this year."

quotes.name: Mesa Enchantress
quotes.flavor: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
quotes.flavor: Here the soratami wove their endless plots—graceful, artful, and deceitful, while the unwitting world moved below.

quotes.name: Rootbound Crag
quotes.flavor:
"I been ta space, a buncha dimensions 'n' universes . . . and I always end up right back here on Yancy Street."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Devour in Shadow
quotes.flavor:
"Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

quotes.name: Rapid Decay
quotes.flavor: The grave robbers arrived the day after the burial. They were a day too late.

quotes.name: Moonlight Geist
quotes.flavor: Wails and whispers are the only weapons she has left.

quotes.name: Dream Spoilers
quotes.flavor: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.

quotes.name: Tree Monkey
quotes.flavor: The vines and branches of the jungle canopy are all the wings it needs.

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Witches' Eye
quotes.flavor: The price of prophecy is a vacant eye socket.

quotes.name: Yixlid Jailer
quotes.flavor: He holds the keys to a tombful of incarcerated secrets.

quotes.name: Knights of the Black Rose
quotes.flavor: "Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!"

quotes.name: Infantry Veteran
quotes.flavor: "Any fool can pick up a sword and charge into battle. To emerge alive at the end, that is a gift that comes from leadership and experience."

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Chasm Skulker
quotes.flavor: Designed by Mike Neumann

quotes.name: Behold the Sinister Six!
quotes.flavor:
"Open your eyes to your nightmare, Spider-Man."
—Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius

quotes.name: Topple
quotes.flavor:
"Let all witness the fate of those who defy me."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Light Up the Stage
quotes.flavor:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

quotes.name: Magus of the Bazaar
quotes.flavor: "Some trade in goods, some in secrets. My soul has walked the futures, and I offer the rare coin of possibility."

quotes.name: Command Beacon
quotes.flavor:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

quotes.name: Grisly Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"You can always tell who's new from the screaming."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

quotes.name: Goblin Raider
quotes.flavor: He's smart for a goblin. He can do *two* things: hit *and* run.

quotes.name: Minister of Pain
quotes.flavor: Draconic words need not be shouted. A whisper will suffice.

quotes.name: Vein Ripper
quotes.flavor: "I'm afraid your investigation has reached a dead end."

quotes.name: Control of the Court
quotes.flavor: "Power-hungry eunuchs, the curse of the dynasty, have thrown the masses of the people into the depths of misery."

quotes.name: Thoughtseize
quotes.flavor: "Any dream is a robust harvest. Still, I prefer the timeworn dreams, heavy with import, that haunt the obsessive mind."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

quotes.name: Innovative Commons
quotes.flavor:
"Proud to announce we've invented a *voice-activated* void portal! No gestures needed!"
—Stingerquill and Theorix joint project

quotes.name: Claim the Firstborn
quotes.flavor:
「ヴィル！フェイの物語があるわ！寝る前に読み聞かせてあげましょうか？」
—-ローアン・ケンリス

quotes.name: Tangled Colony
quotes.flavor: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

quotes.name: Arrogant Wurm
quotes.flavor: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

quotes.name: Akroma's Vengeance
quotes.flavor: "Many must die for the one who should not have perished."

quotes.name: Fervent Cathar
quotes.flavor: "I'll put my sword down only to die. And I don't plan on doing that today."

quotes.name: Orcish Lumberjack
quotes.flavor:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

quotes.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
quotes.flavor: Great hero or grand betrayer? The truth of Ezuri's legacy is clouded by the fog of legend.

quotes.name: Karn's Bastion
quotes.flavor:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

quotes.name: Talara's Battalion
quotes.flavor: The safewright Talara protects a delicate woodland waterfall. She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.
